subject: Temporary concurrency floor and pro-rata invoice offset
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@switchboard.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@switchboard.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: minute-scale headroom purchase for 48hr launch window

Connor —

Quick one from our infra team: we have a product launch spike that'll hit peak QPS for a couple of critical minutes across two days next week (Oct 20–21). Can Redwood provision a short-term concurrency floor (minute-scale headroom) for up to ~120k extra tokens/min for a 48-hour window?

We are prepared to prepay an uplift for that window; ideally a simple blended rate so our finance team can do a one-line PO. Also attaching a short request doc with expected curve and telemetry we can share.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm pricing for a 48-hour minute-level headroom (approx numbers in attached PDF)?
- Can Redwood apply the payment as a pro-rata offset on our following month invoice rather than a separate one-off? That helps our AP process.

Thanks — can you loop in pricing/legal as needed.

—Emma
Product Ops, Switchboard Labs
Attachment: switchboard_temp_headroom_request.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@switchboard.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minute-scale headroom purchase for 48hr launch window

Emma — thanks for the clear note and the telemetry doc. We can definitely do a minute-level headroom product for a short window. High level: we offer a prepay option with blended per-token uplift + a small surcharge for very short windows to cover burst provisioning.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with two pricing bands (standard blended uplift, and a 10% blended discount if you commit to a 3-month rolling true-up tied to this purchase). The spreadsheet shows the PO amount we would invoice and how it would apply as a credit on the next month invoice (pro-rata offset).

Next steps I propose:
- We confirm the exact start/end times (I can schedule the provision to the minute).
- If you accept the 3-month true-up option, we'll include a short amendment (DocuSign) and knock 10% off the uplift.
- If you prefer a single-window purchase with no commitment, we'll apply the standard uplift + one-off surcharge.

I've looped in Ben and Laura for formal pricing approval and for the DocuSign/amendment flow.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: sprint_trueup_calc.xlsx (Excel, 18 KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@switchboard.ai>
Date: 2026-10-16T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minute-scale headroom purchase for 48hr launch window

Connor / Emma —

Quick pricing note from finance: we can offer a 10% discount on the blended uplift if Switchboard signs the 3-month true-up amendment. The amendment just says the headroom amount will be reconciled against actual consumption each month and excesss/shortfall carried forward (standard language).

If you want the single-window option, the uplift will be 1.45x our normal per-token rate for the minutes covered plus a $2k short-window provisioning surcharge. With the 3-month true-up, the surcharge drops to $750 and blended rate becomes 1.25x.

We can prepare the amendment and a single-line PO invoice as Connor suggested. Laura will run the DocuSign.

—Ben
Senior Sales Finance, Redwood Inference
